files.note: threads_own_kahf.csv (a Threads profile scraper, scraped 03:39 UTC on 22 Oct): 200 posts by @kahfeveryday and @kahfeveryday.my back to July 2025; the 4 from 17 Oct kept, all @kahfeveryday's 22 Oct statement (10:01 WIB) and the three posts that continue it in its own thread (listed in drop_urls with the statement as their parent). Columns renamed only; times ISO with a zone.

thread_kahf_ref.csv and thread_khaf_ref.csv (a Threads keyword search for "kahf" and "khaf", 513 posts each, 2 in both): 421 posted from 17 Oct (to 01:05 WIB on 22 Oct), one row per post, the larger reading kept. Replies found by the search are loaded as posts, as in kahf-threads. No views or followers in the search. Columns renamed only.
tiktok_own_kahf.csv (Apify TikTok profile scraper): @kahfeveryday's last 50 videos, 20 to 21 Oct, all from 17 Oct. Columns renamed only.
tiktok_kahf.csv (Apify TikTok search for "kahf", 282 videos): 71 posted from 17 Oct, some of them @kahfeveryday's and @kahfeveryday.my's own (those count as own). Columns renamed only.

twitter_kahf.csv (an X search for "kahf", 1,000 tweets, one repeated): 245 posted from 17 Oct (to 09:22 WIB on 22 Oct). Most are Friday reminders to read Surah Al-Kahf. twitter_own_kahf.csv (@kahfeveryday) holds nothing from 17 Oct and is not loaded; the scraper found no @kahfeveryday.my on X. Columns renamed only.

dataset_threads-replies-scraper_2026-10-22_06-19-45-159.csv (Apify Threads replies scraper, 06:19 UTC on 22 Oct): 80 replies to @kahfeveryday's 22 Oct statement, 10:00 to 13:17 WIB, one of them Kahf's own continuation (kept as Kahf's reply, never labelled); the post's own row left out. ISO times with Z. Columns renamed only.
